## Public documentation change

Describe the installation, release policy, security-language or compatibility documentation change:

## Evidence and scope

- [ ] I changed only public documentation or issue templates. No application source or signed release binary is included.
- [ ] All links and product claims match the documented **current** production release state.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, provider tokens, account labels, private build logs, Vault backups, cookies or user profiles.
- [ ] I did not modify or attempt to publish `gh-pages/updates.json` or XPI release assets.

Signed XPI releases and changes to the update channel are approved only through the protected private-source workflow.
